about.label: About Us
about.title: We're on a mission to make finance simple for everyone
about.subtitle: Finance AI was built by a small team of developers and designers who were frustrated with complex, expensive financial tools. We set out to build something better.
about.storyTitle: Started with a spreadsheet, built into a platform
about.storyP1: It started in 2026 when our founder, tired of juggling spreadsheets and disconnected banking apps, decided to build a unified finance tracker. What began as a personal project quickly grew into something thousands of people wanted.
about.storyP2: Today, Finance AI combines real-time transaction tracking, AI-powered insights, and beautiful visualizations into one platform — available in 15 languages and trusted by users across 40+ countries.
about.value1Desc: Your financial data is encrypted and protected with bank-grade security at every layer.
about.value2Desc: We believe powerful tools should be fast and easy to use, not complex and overwhelming.
about.value3Desc: Every feature we build starts with a real user problem. Your feedback shapes our roadmap.
about.value4Desc: Multi-language, multi-currency support so anyone, anywhere can take control of their finances.
about.value5Desc: We never sell your data. You own it, you control it, and you can export it anytime.
about.value6Desc: 50,000+ users help us improve every day. We grow together with our community.
about.techSubtitle: Every tool chosen for a reason — performance, developer experience, and reliability.
about.quote1: We ship fast, learn faster, and always put the user first.
about.quote2: Great financial tools should feel invisible — they just work.
